verdict: Organic traffic is holding; paid ads remain off and GBP has gone quiet.
narrative: Paid advertising has been inactive for the full 28-day period, meaning no spend, no paid leads, and no cost per lead to report this period. Organic search is carrying all traffic, with your site receiving 1,669 sessions and 657 search clicks in the last 28 days — the only active inbound channel. Your Google Business Profile generated 155 actions (54 calls, 101 web clicks) across the period, but activity dropped to zero over the last 7 days, pointing to a listing or tracking issue that is being investigated now. A few account-level items — including engagement scope and CRM automation access — are pending your sign-off and are directly tied to reactivating paid campaigns and improving how incoming contacts are handled. Once those are resolved, paid channels and automated follow-up can be switched back on ahead of the October milestones already on the plan.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile activity dropped to zero for the last 7 days after averaging roughly 8 actions per day through August — calls and clicks are not being captured.
watch_item.fix: A listing and tracking audit is underway now, with the goal of restoring full visibility before the end of this week.
